summary_en: ENEOS Holdings will acquire a 65% stake in Roadmap Holdings from Goldman Sachs, making NIPPO a 100% subsidiary. The acquisition reflects changed business strategy toward synergies in asphalt supply chain optimization, asset utilization, and Southeast Asian growth opportunities.
title_en: Notice of Full Subsidiary Status for NIPPO through Additional Acquisition of Shares in Roadmap Holdings, a Subsidiary of ENEOS
translation_en_brief:
ENEOS Holdings announced on October 23, 2026, that its subsidiary Roadmap Holdings will acquire a 65% stake in Roadmap Holdings from Goldman Sachs (which holds the stake through special purpose vehicles Aether Holdings and JL QU LLC), making NIPPO a 100% owned subsidiary of the ENEOS Group. ENEOS currently owns 35% of Roadmap Holdings, and Goldman Sachs holds 59.5% with JL QU holding 5.5%.

ENEOS had previously delisted NIPPO in 2021 to strengthen governance, establishing a joint ownership structure with Goldman Sachs while positioning NIPPO as an independent company targeting eventual re-listing. However, the company's business environment and growth strategy have evolved. ENEOS now prioritizes strengthening earnings from core operations and acquiring businesses offering near-term revenue contributions. This shift has clarified significant synergy opportunities previously underexplored.

Key synergies driving the acquisition include: (1) domestic asphalt supply chain optimization, where ENEOS produces asphalt as a byproduct of petroleum refining and chemical production while NIPPO uses it for asphalt mixture manufacturing and road paving; (2) cross-group asset utilization initiatives leveraging NIPPO's expertise in soil improvement and construction; and (3) Southeast Asian expansion opportunities, where NIPPO's existing overseas business base can support ENEOS's petroleum and sales business globalization in a region with growing road infrastructure demand. Full subsidiary status will enable unified operational management and rapid decision-making to enhance competitive advantages through joint R&D, process optimization, and new business creation across both the asphalt value chain and real estate development.
